method: Read-only saved files and pure Decimal arithmetic; no guard entry, lock acquisition, provider call, allocation or ledger change.
supported_reconciliation: No settlement/refund command or journal record type exists. Every reservation remains a nonnegative permanent debit for the cycle, added to observed spend. Manual review is named for malformed or missing evidence, changed grants and unresolved cleanup; it does not implement credit restoration for completed runs. A different accounting policy would require an explicit separately reviewed policy/code change and is outside this read-only task.
concrete_options: Continue the existing official evaluation and offline work; no Modal spend is needed.
Prepare and review a bounded SK2 diagnostic without allocating; dry-run does not prove it fits current credits or compiles.
Use an authorized official private diagnostic only if its source and quota have independent review; it does not recover Modal allowance.
sk2_diagnostic_fit: No legal60..900-second timeout fits unchanged guard; compilation or profiling duration cannot change that result.
limitations: Latest billing is a saved06:30UTC snapshot, not a fresh provider balance.
No claim that actual Modal free credits are depleted: the local working allowance is exhausted by intentional double-counting.
No current provider application-state check or lock acquisition was performed.
